description.text: Clinical medicine is the science of studying the etiology, diagnosis, treatment and prognosis of diseases, improving the level of clinical treatment and promoting human health. During the undergraduate period, I mainly studied mathematics, physics, chemistry and other natural science courses, as well as biomedical science, public health, medical humanities and other courses. Clinical medicine specialties include internal medicine, surgery, obstetrics and gynecology, pediatrics and other clinical courses

duration.text: The MBBS at SHANDONG SECOND MEDICAL UNIVERSITY is a 6 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3333 USD/per year ￥ 24000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3. Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4. Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1. Aged 18 or above2. High school graduate or above, or have passed Grade Twelve (10+2)/FSc./A Level/WAEC or equivalent.3. At least 60% score in science subjects: Mathematics, English, Biology, Physics and Chemistry.4. Have basic English language ability;
